title: Poppi Soda Recipe
description: A homemade fruit soda inspired by Poppi, made with sparkling water, fruit juice and optional vinegar; no added caffeine or fiber supplements.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: Lemon or lime juice and sweetener to taste (optional)
Ice and fruit slices, to serve
instructions:
1. Mix fruit juice with optional vinegar and a squeeze of lemon or lime. Sweeten to taste if desired.
  2. Just before serving, add sparkling water and stir gently.
  3. Serve over ice with fruit slices.
notes: This is not the commercial formula or a detox drink. Serve freshly mixed for best fizz.
keywords: Poppi soda recipe, carbonated drinks, soda, summer drinks
